title: Platform registry and governed recovery
text: Governed Postgres models live on an environment box without retired cloud coordinates; box is the only environment database.location. Box db-admin setup needs only the model database_name, the provisioned DSN file and the environment's servers[0] mac_host and mac_host_key_fingerprint: it creates a per-machine Mac-host key and the operator key under ~/.yoke/secrets, pins the Mac host's key only when its fingerprint matches, and proves the Mac-host key against the host's forced hop command before writing its SSH hop to ~/.yoke/ssh/config. A machine whose public key is not in the host's hop key list refuses box_mac_host_key_unauthorized with the config unchanged. Repeated setup uses the selected profile's saved local port unless --local-port is supplied. Before SSH or profile changes, setup checks that the provisioned DSN names a loopback endpoint on that port. For a mismatch, rerun with --local-port set to the provisioned DSN port or provision a DSN for the intended port. Setup then authorizes the operator key, pins the VM host key, and never reads or edits ~/.ssh.
